PUBLICATION–National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) – U.S. Coast Pilot 7, Pacific Coast: 
California, 58th Edition, 2026, has been issued and is ready for free download and weekly updates at 
www.nauticalcharts.noaa.gov/publications/coast-pilot/index.html.
Only Print-on-Demand (POD) bound copies are available for purchase; visit 
nauticalcharts.noaa.gov/publications/print-agents.html#coast-pilot.
The 2026 Edition cancels the preceding 2025 Edition, and incorporates all previous corrections.
